# Verify: full test suite and build pass after multiplier retune

## Goal
Verify the quartered reputation-based income coin multiplier change is green across the entire project — full `npm test` (unit, browser, tutorial stages) and `npm run build` succeed with no regressions.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `npm test` passes — the full CI suite (unit → non-tutorial browser → tutorial E2E stages via `scripts/run-ci-tests.sh`) is green.
2. `npm run build` succeeds — TypeScript compilation and Vite production build complete without errors.
3. Targeted unit runs (`npx vitest run --project unit tests/main-street/` and `tests/rule-engine/`) pass, confirming the updated test expectations from the implementation item.
4. No leftover references to old multiplier values (20 / 3.0 / 1.15× default) remain in the multiplier test files or `MainStreetDifficulty.ts` (spot-check via grep).

## Notes

- Run after the implementation item is committed. This is the final gate before the parent item advances to `in_review`.
- Per repo quality gates: full `npm test` + `npm run build` are required before any push to origin.
- The audit skill's read-only test cache can consume a green full-suite run for subsequent audits of the same git state — run this suite cleanly at the commit under review.

## Key Files
- `package.json` — npm scripts invoked (`test`, `build`)
- `scripts/run-ci-tests.sh` — full test suite orchestrator
data.title: Verify: full test suite and build pass after multiplier retune
